title: Gentle Rain in a Misty Forest for Sleeping - Soft Rain on Leaves, No Thunder | 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of gentle rain falling through an old misty forest at night. Soft drops on leaves, ferns and mossy ground over a steady, even hush. No thunder, no music, no talking.
The rain never loops, with a gentle fade in and a slow fade out at the end. Made for falling asleep, staying asleep, reading and study.
